title: xdrip doesn't connect to blucon at all.
body: changed batteries, changed libre sensor, reinstalled xdrip and set all advised settings, however it doesn't collect any data. it connects via BT, i enter pass but it never gets 2 readings from transmitter. STATUS is 'bonded', but disconnected or connected on 'connection status'. tried change many settings, no improvement.

comments.body:
sorry to hear this. I am about to update documentation, this might help you.

A quick try:
- Trust Connect to ON
- GATT disconnect to off

or try contrary

reboot phone and reset Blucon between each tries.

Which phone?
which xdrip version?

phone oneplus 6, android 9.0 pie .
latest xdrip version. no changes with these tips. 
ive ordered miao miao, hopefully this one works better, because blucon didn't work well since i bought it 3 months ago and their service is to treat you like fool.

Miao Miao is excellent. Currently using it without issues. Use Glimp S to activate with nfc (literally instant - will give you extremely high reading when the sensor first warms up, so don't bother doing nfc scans, open xdrip+ app and select start sensor from the left menu- select not today - wait for 3 readings, then enter two manual calibrations from your glucometer - all done. If you want any help/tips, let me know. This setup works excellent with my Pebble Time Steel, Ticwatch E, and Ticwatch Pro.

Thanks! Using xdrip with blucon and would like to use it, so do i need to
download glimpse app or i can simply scan with xdrip? Using pebble and not
many questions atm, until i receive maio maio.
